theme_note: These passages hold together because participants initiate a Drifter image, locate it, join the furthest-along version, or add its partner; what varies is whether they recruit, choose coordinates, merge duplicate starts, or report progress.
Participants seek account-assisted scripting or recruit others to run a supplied Guardian script; what varies is whether the script is only requested or operational instructions are given.

second_order: making the picture easier to build correctly
theme_note: Participants add a grid, frame, alliance guide, and visual instructions so helpers know what to place and what not to damage; what varies is whether the aid concerns the Drifter itself or the wider neighborhood.

Participants work out whether neighboring art will permit, approve, constrain, or displace a build; what varies is approval, compromise, threatened force, documentary proof, and relocating the Guardian.

second_order: helping neighbors keep each other's art
theme_note: Participants promise, return, formalize, and later celebrate mutual upkeep with neighboring communities; what varies is bilateral help, a broader alliance, and retrospective credit.

second_order: finishing and keeping the hero alive
theme_note: Participants shift from completing the image to supplying coordinates, fighting griefing and random pixels, and directing late arrivals toward defense; what varies is the moment of completion and the maintenance task named.

second_order: arguing whether the coat should be orange or pink
theme_note: Participants dispute which available color best represents the Drifter and whether changing it is worth the effort; what varies is fidelity to in-game color, recognition from promo art, and willingness to concede.

second_order: moving planning to Discord and bringing the story back
theme_note: Participants invite planning on Discord, discover it late, read its history, or recount its membership and work back on Reddit; what varies is direct participation, late discovery, and deliberate non-use.

second_order: thanking helpers and celebrating an intact finish
theme_note: Participants thank supporters, credit effort and diplomacy, and celebrate the Hero or Drifter as intact and immortalized; what varies is praise for individual labor, small-community pride, duration of struggle, and admiration of the final image.
